findings.summary: Approach Generation Protocol Step 1 enumerates solution-space axes but does not declare a DELTA output mode for revision cycles; remediation cycles re-emit the full proposal set instead of a delta.
findings.recommendation: Add a DELTA OUTPUT MODE section that activates when remediation_context is present, gating output on a pre-generation Read of each reviewer-artifact path.

findings.summary: Backward-compat is implicit; without an explicit optional marker on remediation_context the agent cannot signal that the absent case preserves prior output shape.
findings.recommendation: Add remediation_context to Inputs with an explicit optional marker and preserve the existing `proposals` field heading in the Output Format.
